# temporal binding effect
```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE
)

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(gghalves) 
# remotes::install_github("teunbrand/gghalves@compat_ggplot2_400")
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(cols4all)
library(patchwork)
library(rprojroot)
proj_root <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::has_file_pattern("\\.Rproj$"))
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = proj_root)
```

## load data
```{r}
source("analysis/01_temporal_binding_effect/temporal_binding_effect_utils.R")
# ---------- paths ----------
dir_pdf <- "figures/01_temporal_binding_effect"
dir_res <- "results/01_temporal_binding_effect"
ensure_dir(dir_pdf); ensure_dir(dir_res)

# ---------- load processed data used in paper ----------
perceptual_shift_action_outcome <- read_csv("data/01_temporal_binding_effect/perceptual_shift_action_outcome.csv", locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8"))

perceptual_shift_probability <- read_csv("data/01_temporal_binding_effect/perceptual_shift_probability.csv")
```


## Plot raw perceptual shift
```{r}
df_action <- to_long(
  perceptual_shift_action_outcome,
  cols   = c("va_ba", "ia_bi"),
  levels = c("va_ba", "ia_bi"),
  labels = c("Voluntary", "Involuntary")
)

df_outcome <- to_long(
  perceptual_shift_action_outcome,
  cols   = c("vs_bs", "is_bs"),
  levels = c("vs_bs", "is_bs"),
  labels = c("Voluntary", "Involuntary")
)

df_without <- to_long(
  perceptual_shift_probability,
  cols   = c("a75_an_ba", "a50_an_ba"),
  levels = c("a75_an_ba", "a50_an_ba"),
  labels = c("75% probability\n(without outcome)", "50% probability\n(without outcome)")
)

df_50 <- to_long(
  perceptual_shift_probability,
  cols   = c("a50_an_ba", "a50_ay_ba"),
  levels = c("a50_an_ba", "a50_ay_ba"),
  labels = c("50% probability\n(without outcome)", "50% probability\n(with outcome)")
)

# palettes
pal_action  <- c4a('10',6)[1:2]
pal_outcome <- c4a('10',6)[3:4]
pal_without <- c4a('10',6)[5:6]
pal_50    <- c4a('10',8)[6:7]

p_action  <- plot_halfviolin(df_action,  "Action", y_breaks = seq(-125, 175, 25), palette = pal_action)
p_outcome <- plot_halfviolin(df_outcome, "Sound",  y_breaks = seq(-400,   0, 50), palette = pal_outcome)
p_without <- plot_halfviolin(df_without, "Action", y_breaks = seq(-150, 175, 25), palette = pal_without)
p_50    <- plot_halfviolin(df_50,    "Action", y_breaks = seq(-125, 175, 25), palette = pal_50)

p_action
p_outcome
p_without
p_50

# save PDFs only
save_plot_pdf(p_action,  "action_binding",               dir_pdf)
save_plot_pdf(p_outcome, "outcome_binding",              dir_pdf)
save_plot_pdf(p_without, "75_vs_50_without_outcome",     dir_pdf)
save_plot_pdf(p_50,    "50_without_vs_with_outcome",        dir_pdf)

```

## Condition comparisons
```{r}
tests_paired <- bind_rows(
  paired_tests(perceptual_shift_probability$a75_an_ba,  perceptual_shift_probability$a50_an_ba,
                  "Without outcome: 75% vs 50%"),
  paired_tests(perceptual_shift_probability$a75_ay_ba,  perceptual_shift_probability$a50_ay_ba,
                  "With outcome: 75% vs 50%"),
  paired_tests(perceptual_shift_probability$a50_ay_ba,  perceptual_shift_probability$a50_an_ba,
                  "50%: With outcome vs Without outcome")
)

tests_one_sample <- bind_rows(
  one_sample_tests(perceptual_shift_action_outcome$va_ba, "Action: Voluntary vs 0"),
  one_sample_tests(perceptual_shift_action_outcome$ia_bi, "Action: Involuntary vs 0"),
  one_sample_tests(perceptual_shift_action_outcome$vs_bs, "Outcome: Voluntary vs 0"),
  one_sample_tests(perceptual_shift_action_outcome$is_bs, "Outcome: Involuntary vs 0")
)

write_csv(tests_paired,     file.path(dir_res, "paired_tests.csv"))
write_csv(tests_one_sample, file.path(dir_res, "one_sample_tests.csv"))

tests_paired
tests_one_sample

```
